detailed_description: LTX2-Ti2VidTwoStages is an audio-video generation diffusion model. This config exposes a video generation interface (text-to-video with optional image conditioning).

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description: Optional conditioning image URL (for image-to-video / first-frame conditioning). Supported formats: .jpg/.jpeg/.png. Max 10MB.

parameters.name: guidance_scale
parameters.description: Classifier-free guidance scale (CFG). Higher values increase prompt adherence but may reduce diversity.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output video height in pixels. LTX-2 typically requires height divisible by 32.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output video width in pixels. LTX-2 typically requires width divisible by 32.

parameters.name: num_frames
parameters.description: Number of video frames to generate. LTX-2 commonly expects frames = (8 x K) + 1 (e.g., 121).

parameters.name: fps
parameters.description: Output video frame rate (frames per second).

parameters.name: num_inference_steps
parameters.description: Number of denoising steps. Higher values improve quality but increase latency.
